name: UiElement
description: Renderer for branded UI assets, currently including the Ceneo logo.

semantics.decorativeBehavior: Elements without a label are decorative; labeled elements expose their accessible name.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of an asset from the UI element catalog.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible image alternative text. Omit when surrounding content names the brand.

accessibility: Use label as the image alternative text when the image conveys information.
Render an empty alt and aria-hidden=true when the image is decorative.
Prevent the image from being dragged.
adaptationRules: Implement UiElement as a reusable component in the target application's framework.
Load the existing SVG assets from the client application's asset pipeline.
Preserve the original logo proportions and colors.
Do not install dependencies solely for this component.
